# Bombsell

> Bombsell reads a company website to generate a buyer profile, tracks buying signals, and automates email and LinkedIn outreach.

Bombsell extracts data such as job postings, funding events, and leadership changes, then uses the information to personalize outreach and schedule demos.

## Home
- [Bombsell Home](https://bombsell.com): Overview of the buyer profiling and automated outreach service.
